_meta.status: POC. Lives under tools/CombatSim/tuning/ until the spec is built; the shipped home is data/tuning/aptitudes.v{n}.json.
_meta.note: The whole balance surface of the class system, in one file. Nothing here is a code constant. Four blocks: grant is the point ECONOMY, read is the two SCALE functions (PS-3), familyRead is the unitClass DECISION per family, edges is the DISTRIBUTION. Channels name their source rather than aptitudes listing their channels (class-system-ideal.md 7a.1).
_meta.coverage: 2026-08-25: extended from 48 combat-only edges to cover the RESOURCE, PROGRESSION, SKILL, STATUS, MOVEMENT and HEAL layers. The 48-edge version measured a fight in which hp was a flat constant no aptitude could buy - so defence-by-mitigation was the only survival lever and had no competitor. See class-system-ideal.md 5a.
_meta.measurable: Only the COMBAT and hp/shield edges are measurable by CombatSim today. stamina/qi/hunger/spirit, skill.cooldown, resource.efficiency and move.range price actions, and the action layer is not built - their coefficients here are DESIGNED, not measured, and must not be reported as balanced.
_meta.rebalance: Never hand-edit. python tools/tuning/publish.py aptitudes <dotted.key>=<value> writes v{n+1}; the old version stays on disk for revert (tunables-ssot.md T4).
_meta.statusEdgesFrozen: UNFROZEN 2026-08-25: the neutral-point blocker is built (applyShape/applyOffsetK) and the duration/intensity axes are now fed, so these are tunable. BUT the re-solved allocation FAILED its falsification (30.4% max residual, one arrow reversed) - see class-system-ideal.md 5c.13. Treat builds/*.json as UNVERIFIED, not as balance.

grant._note: FREE BUILD (owner, 2026-08-25): the player has no class, so there is no class price and no posture surcharge - every point costs one point. The withdrawn price block is class-system-ideal.md 7a.3; what it was FOR now lives entirely in read.*.shareExponentMilli.

read._note: PS-3, made into two tunable FUNCTIONS rather than two hard-coded reads. Both take the aptitude share of the spent points; neither takes an absolute count. Share is bounded [0,1], which is what makes level cancel at parity (ssot-power-scale.md 2).
read._naming: The two modes are named for PS-3's own vocabulary, but the property that actually matters is SCALE BEHAVIOUR, not opposition: contest = Theta-FREE, magnitude = proportional to P(Theta). A bounded ratio with no opposing side (resource.efficiency, progression.breakthroughSuccess, skill.cooldown) takes the CONTEST read because it must be Theta-free, not because anything contests it.

contest._note: value = kMilli/1000 * share^gamma * spanPoints. spanPoints is how many CONTEST POINTS one whole allocation is worth - a different concept from stats.accuracyScale, which is how many contest points move a probability. Both must exist; neither may be derived from the other.

magnitude._note: value = kMilli/1000 * share^gamma * P(Theta). The ladder supplies the scale; the player supplies the share.

recovery._note: The TERMINATION INVARIANT dial (class-system-ideal.md 5d). Multiplies every edge whose channel starts with one of `families` below. Recovery is sized against PEER DAMAGE, never against the pool it refills: with r = recovery/peerDamage, a fight stretches by 1/(1-r) and r >= 1 means it never ends. Measured before this dial existed: r = 1.33 on a max-Vigor mirror, i.e. an unkillable pair.
recovery._scaleWhy: 374 = 0.374x, SOLVED not inverted. Measured r without the dial was 1.33 (an unkillable pair). Target r = 0.670 -> a max-sustain build stretches a fight exactly 3x. r is NOT linear in the dial, because nerfing recovery also shortens the fight and so moves DAMAGE: 500 -> r 0.79, 424 -> 0.76, 374 -> 0.670. Three passes, each measured. Re-solve after any coefficient change that touches damage - the coupling means the dial does not hold still on its own.
recovery._targetWhy: The ACCEPTANCE CRITERION, not the dial - what balance-guard checks. 670 means a max-sustain build may stretch a fight 3x and no further. It is a share of peer damage, so it is Theta-free like every other ratio here.

mitigation._note: Recovery's own sibling dial (class-system-todo.md P8.3) for non-recovery survivability -- combat.defense/dodge/parry/block/absorption/heal, channels recovery.families never reaches. Ported into this tool 2026-08-27, matching the live data/tuning/aptitudes.v2.json calibration exactly (docs/research/class-residual-2026-08-27.md) -- this tool's own resolver was blind to the dial until now, which is what left P3.4/P8.1/Checkpoint 8's baselines silently understating mitigation.

familyRead._note: THE unitClass DECISION, as one reviewable block rather than a flag on every edge - because the read mode is a property of the CHANNEL (what the formula compares it against), never of the edge that feeds it. Rule (measured, class-rps-balance-2026-08-25.md 3.1): a family compared against a LADDER quantity is a magnitude; a family feeding a bounded ratio through a small scale is a contest.
familyRead._resourceNote: resource.max/regen are POOL SIZES and RATES measured against damage, which is P(Theta)-scaled - so they are magnitudes, and a Theta-free read would make every pool vanish relative to the hit that empties it. resource.efficiency is a bounded 0..1 cost ratio (cap 1.0) and must stay Theta-free.

edges._group: === COMBAT: the universal pair. Sourced by all three postures (rule 9) ===

=== RESOURCE: every pool shared across ALL 12 aptitudes at different scales (owner, 2026-08-25). Tier 4 is a nonzero FLOOR: a build that can reach zero of a universal pool cannot act at all - measured, BASTION had zero stamina and qi regen and took 8,725 rounds to kill anything ===

=== STATUS: six families x (omni + category). Aptitudes reach a MECHANISM (dot/cc/contagion), never a FLAVOUR (the per-id tier is the skill layer, 5c.10). duration/intensity are fed so they CONTEST the shared base instead of inheriting it, which is what stops netFactor being quadratic (5c.11) ===

=== MITIGATION CHAIN: one PRIMARY stage per aptitude. The chain is a product of four stages, so an aptitude holding several is superlinear in its own share - moving one stage moved dominance from Vigor to Fortitude in one edit (8.8) ===
